evals.title: PR #96: DB name and DB username can differ; enhance code to take this into account
evals.prompt: Review PR #96 'DB name and DB username can differ; enhance code to take this into account'. This PR adds login_db to a PostgreSQL query in roles/postgresql/tasks/db_export.yml so the version-check query works when the DB name differs from the DB username. Review it following the project review format.
evals.expected_output: A structured review confirming the fix is correct and scoped to the RPM/containerized version-check query, and (as an Incidental Finding, since it's pre-existing and outside the diff) noting that the dump task and the OCP-path query in the same file could have the same class of connection-parameter issue, and that the dump task on line 39-49 is missing no_log despite passing login_password.

assertions.text: Review confirms the login_db fix addresses the DB name vs username mismatch
assertions.description: Reviewer should recognize the fix correctly targets the version-check query

assertions.text: Review notes the missing no_log on the 'Perform a PostgreSQL dump.' task as an incidental/pre-existing finding
assertions.description: The dump task passes login_password with no no_log — a real, pre-existing gap in the same file the PR touches

assertions.text: Review follows the standard format template
assertions.description: Review follows the project's standard review structure

evals.title: Authoring: add a 5th AAP component following the delegator-role pattern
evals.prompt: This collection currently exports/imports 4 AAP components: controller, eda, gateway, hub. Sketch what's needed to add a 5th component called 'lightspeed' — specifically, write the new roles/automationlightspeed/tasks/export.yml, roles/automationlightspeed/tasks/import.yml, and roles/automationlightspeed/vars/main.yml, plus the new entry to add to _operations_component_config in roles/operations/vars/main.yml. Use roles/automationcontroller as the structural reference.
evals.expected_output: New task files that delegate to the operations role via include_role + component_name, a vars/main.yml setting automationlightspeed_component_name: lightspeed, and a plausible _operations_component_config entry — not a reimplementation of export/import logic inline in the new delegator role.

assertions.text: New export.yml/import.yml delegate to the operations role rather than reimplementing logic
assertions.description: Component roles are thin delegators — real logic belongs in the operations engine

assertions.text: component_name is passed via vars into the include_role call
assertions.description: component_name is the universal parameter that selects the config block in _operations_component_config

assertions.text: vars/main.yml sets a single fixed component_name fact

evals.title: Review: hypothetical MR touching roles/postgresql/tasks/db_export.yml
evals.prompt: A teammate is proposing a change to roles/postgresql/tasks/db_export.yml that adds a new 'Get database size' community.postgresql.postgresql_query task right after the existing 'Get PostgreSQL server version' task, using the same login_host/login_port/login_user/login_password parameters. They did not add no_log to the new task. Review this proposed change following the project review format, using the actual file at roles/postgresql/tasks/db_export.yml for context.
evals.expected_output: A critical finding that the new task passes login_password without no_log, referencing the canonical no_log expression from the conventions skill, and ideally noting the existing 'Perform a PostgreSQL dump.' task in the same file has the identical gap.

assertions.text: Review flags the missing no_log on the new query task as Critical
assertions.description: A task passing login_password with no no_log is a Critical security finding per the review skill

assertions.text: Review references the canonical computed no_log expression
assertions.description: Fix should point at the project's canonical no_log pattern, not a hardcoded no_log: true
